execution_authorization.user_request: run experinment for credibility and conformability
execution_authorization.scope: Local baseline review-quality judging and matching Storage-only MD/CSV exports. No reviewer regeneration, WarrantRoute, optional modules, or manuscript changes.

purpose: Retrospective quality audit of existing review bundles, not document repair or blinded detection validation.

deferred_methods.WarrantRoute: Requires explicit route-policy and reviewer-output version alignment before inclusion. No fallback routing.

primary_judge_candidate.selection_reason: Matches the judge model name used in the previous n5/n25 quality evaluations. Historical digests were not recorded. Self-family preference remains a limitation.

secondary_judge_candidate.role: Optional different-family sensitivity judge. Freeze its own settings before activation. Do not replace primary scores.

proposed_generation.effective_runtime_defaults: Must be recorded and frozen before the main run.

derived_input_policy: Explicit nested field allowlist, provenance-preserving anonymization, no answer key, builder annotations, model labels or original numeric ratings.

validation_plan.same_request_repeat_scope: One additional evaluation of Generalist for all three reviewer models on 40 audit packets.
validation_plan.order_reversal_scope: One additional evaluation of All roles for all three reviewer models on 40 audit packets.
validation_plan.secondary_judge_scope: One additional evaluation per method-model unit on 40 audit packets.

known_limitations: All 400 historical packet theme names reveal intended flaw names.
Sanitizing judge inputs cannot undo historical reviewer exposure.
Removing builder annotations narrows the retrospective assessment context.
LLM judge decisions are not independent expert ground truth.
Shared source contexts and role outputs create statistical dependence.
Bundle size and writing style can reveal conditions despite identity masking.
The primary Qwen judge also grades Qwen reviewer outputs. Model identity masking does not remove self-family preference.
revision_note: The rubric, judge, prompt and generation settings are unchanged. Run r1 stopped after one technically rejected response: the initial log guard misread truncated=0. Run r2 uses the corrected guard, retains the old attempt separately, and restarts the included canary. No score-based selection occurred.

pass_contract.correct_means: Judge-assessed rubric pass, not expert-verified correctness or intended-label match.
pass_contract.false_rule: At least one required condition fails for an assessable unit.
pass_contract.null_rule: Essential context prevents responsible evaluator assessment. Explain the missing context.
